procedural_matters: The panel of the international jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b).
facts: After race 6, in the Men's Blue fleet, the TC inspected ESP.
The centerboard retention line was not connected.
While rounding mark 3p at the end of leg 3, another control line became entangled with the centerboard retention line of ESP and disconnected it, breaking off a piece of the retention hook.
ESP attempted to reattach the retention line while racing, but was unable to do so.
conclusions: By not racing with the retention line attached to the centerboard, ESP broke class rule 14(f).
decision: ESP is subject to a 30% scoring penalty applied to her score for race 6.
